quest.51301115D7895881.quest_desc: Collector MK2 upgrades a working MK1. The modified recipe uses the previous collector, Dark Matter, glowstone and an Elite Energy Cube.
Remove the old block’s contents before replacing it. Check lighting and EMC delivery after installation; a stronger collector cannot fix a bad connection or a full output.
quest.51301115D7895881.title: Obtain 1 × Energy Collector MK2
quest.51301116379D6B7E.quest_desc: An EMC Export Bus creates filtered items from EMC and sends them to an adjacent inventory. The network needs a Transmutation Module belonging to a player who knows the item, plus enough EMC.
Filter one material and connect a small receiving chest. Check EMC consumption and how you will stop delivery before supplying a large production line.
Use an ordinary Export Bus and actual manufacturing for special components without EMC. The EMC Export Bus cannot assign them a price.
quest.51301116379D6B7E.title: Obtain 1 × ME Transmutation Export Bus
quest.5130111A96A5FE8C.quest_desc: An EMC Import Bus takes eligible items from the adjacent inventory and turns them into EMC. Normally, the network must already know the item through a Transmutation Module owner.
An Alchemical Mastery Card can automatically learn incoming items with EMC. The device owner receives that knowledge; it does not mean every teammate has personally learned the item.
Connect it to a dedicated filtered surplus chest. Keep an ordinary Import Bus for items that should remain physical items in storage.
quest.5130111A96A5FE8C.title: Obtain 1 × ME Transmutation Import Bus
quest.5130111DBC28B806.quest_desc: Low Covalence Dust is an early alchemical reagent. Combine 1 charcoal with 8 ordinary cobblestone blocks to obtain 40 dust.
Check the fuel type: this recipe specifically uses Charcoal. Low, medium and high covalence dust have different recipes and uses; keep a small stock of the grades you need.
quest.5130111DBC28B806.title: Obtain 1 × Low Covalence Dust
quest.5130112B9C04745D.quest_desc: An Anti-Matter Relay handles EMC, receiving it from adjacent devices and passing it on; it can also process eligible items. Its name does not mean it produces Mekanism Antimatter Pellets.
MK1 needs obsidian, a diamond block, an Advanced Capacitor Bank and EMC Core. Place it in a short tested connection between source and consumer, then watch the EMC balance in each block.
quest.5130112B9C04745D.title: Obtain 1 × Anti-Matter Relay MK1
quest.51301135226154BC.quest_desc: Relay MK2 uses MK1, Dark Matter and an Advanced Capacitor Bank. Remove its contents before replacement and restore the connection between EMC source and consumer.
Test while the condenser is spending energy. If EMC accumulates upstream while the consumer starves, inspect transfer capacity and device placement.
quest.51301135226154BC.title: Obtain 1 × Anti-Matter Relay MK2
quest.5130118224E922EC.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Dark Matter Hammer (projecte:dm_hammer). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130118224E922EC.title: Obtain 1 × Dark Matter Hammer
quest.5130118EBF8FE3A1.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Dark Matter Furnace (projecte:dm_furnace). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130118EBF8FE3A1.title: Obtain 1 × Dark Matter Furnace
quest.51301193336CB2D1.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Dark Matter Sword (projecte:dm_sword). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301193336CB2D1.title: Obtain 1 × Dark Matter Sword
quest.51301193C7F044AB.quest_desc: The Transmutation Terminal accesses EMC operations through an ME network with a Transmutation Module. Test by obtaining one known inexpensive material.
The arrow button determines where Shift-clicked items go: ordinary storage or the EMC conversion slot. Check its direction before quickly unloading valuable items.
The bulk-learning button consumes one sample of each newly learnable item from storage and converts it into EMC. Reserve recipe materials first and check the selected mode before using it.
quest.51301193C7F044AB.title: Obtain 1 × ME Transmutation Terminal
quest.51301197D92629DB.quest_desc: Red Matter uses 3 Dark Matter and 6 Aeternalis Fuel. It is the next material tier for collectors, relays and equipment.
One Red Matter Block needs 4 Red Matter. Reserve blocks for the EMC Module and Transmutation Terminal before upgrading the entire energy installation; storage integration has its own material cost.
quest.51301197D92629DB.title: Obtain 1 × Red Matter
quest.5130119B54CF74BE.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Red Morningstar (projecte:rm_morning_star). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130119B54CF74BE.title: Obtain 1 × Red Morningstar
quest.513011A3AC6C6FB0.quest_desc: An ME Transmutation Module connects the placing player’s EMC and learned items to an active ME network. Learned items with EMC become available for crafting; the network itself still needs power.
Place the module yourself, check the EMC balance in a terminal and request one known inexpensive item. Multiple modules from the same player do not multiply that player’s balance.

Modules placed by different players pool their EMC for the network. Agree with the team on how that balance will be spent. Continue manufacturing EMC 0 items with ordinary patterns and production machines.
quest.513011A3AC6C6FB0.title: Obtain 1 × ME Transmutation Module
quest.513011AD19E4FCFC.quest_desc: The Transmutation Tablet brings transmutation access into your inventory. Reserve materials to restore a fixed station if the base still needs one: the tablet recipe consumes a Transmutation Table.
The modified craft also needs Dark Matter Block, an ME Controller, Quantum Processor and Ultimate Energy Cube. Open the finished tablet and check access to your learned materials and EMC.
Portability does not remove EMC 0 restrictions. Carry equipment and protected materials that the tablet cannot reproduce separately on expeditions.
quest.513011AD19E4FCFC.title: Obtain 1 × Transmutation Tablet
quest.513011AFDB9BDA41.quest_desc: The Transmutation Table uses your personal EMC balance and learned items. For a first test, offer a spare ordinary material with positive EMC, check that it is learned, then obtain it again from the available balance.

This pack crafts the table on Avaritia’s 9×9 grid. Alongside the Philosopher’s Stone and EMC Core, prepare an ME Controller, Singularity, Quantum Entangloporter, Crafter Tier 3 and Advanced Capacitor Bank.
The table reproduces eligible items with EMC values. A protected campaign material without a price still needs its normal production line; adding more EMC does not change that condition.
quest.513011AFDB9BDA41.title: Obtain 1 × Transmutation Table
quest.513011B3C61C143A.quest_desc: Relay MK3 needs MK2, Red Matter and an Advanced Capacitor Bank. Upgrade after checking the source: a relay moves EMC, while the production side must sustain the supply.
Test the collector → relay → consumer connection on a small batch after replacement. Preserve input filters and limits so faster processing does not spend reserved materials.
quest.513011B3C61C143A.title: Obtain 1 × Anti-Matter Relay MK3
quest.513011B6729DC139.quest_desc: Select a sample item with positive EMC in the Energy Condenser. Supplied materials become EMC, which the condenser spends on the selected output; leave room and arrange extraction.
Test with a small stock of an ordinary resource first. Verify the target before connecting storage: supplied materials are spent, so filter the input instead of feeding the whole warehouse.
SOQM’s recipe combines an Alchemical Chest, ME Drive, Quantum Entangloporter and EMC Core. Protected EMC 0 materials do not become available transmutation targets.
quest.513011B6729DC139.title: Obtain 1 × Energy Condenser
quest.513011B8CDA70BC7.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Red Matter Pickaxe (projecte:rm_pick). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B8CDA70BC7.title: Obtain 1 × Red Matter Pickaxe
quest.513011BEC205A346.quest_desc: An Energy Collector turns light into EMC and can upgrade alchemical fuel. Place the first collector in a lit location and check its light indicator and energy accumulation.
SOQM’s MK1 recipe needs EMC Core, an Advanced Capacitor Bank and a Nether Star Generator alongside glowstone and a diamond block. It is a late production component.
Start with one collector and one EMC consumer. Expand after verifying transfer and output so you can identify which part limits throughput.
quest.513011BEC205A346.title: Obtain 1 × Energy Collector MK1
quest.513011C06B143334.quest_desc: Condenser MK2 separates input and output, making continuous automation easier. Select a target after installation, supply a test batch and verify where your transport system extracts the result.
The modified recipe consumes MK1, Dark Matter and Red Matter blocks, a Molecular Assembler and a Quantum Entangloporter. Prepare temporary storage before replacing a working condenser.
Higher speed helps when EMC supply and output capacity are sufficient. Continue controlling which materials the input may consume.
quest.513011C06B143334.title: Obtain 1 × Energy Condenser MK2
quest.513011C4E475A5DA.quest_desc: The Philosopher’s Stone comes after EMC Core in this campaign. Its modified recipe uses an Avaritia tier-4 table and a 9×9 grid, combining Neutronium, Crystal Matrix, Quantum Processor, AE2 Singularity and an Ultimate Energy Cube.

Establish those production lines first and reserve components for the Transmutation Table. The stone supports ProjectE’s alchemical recipes; the next lesson explains learning items and spending personal EMC.
The old simple redstone, glowstone and diamond recipe has been replaced. Campaign components assigned EMC 0 still require their own manufacturing processes.
quest.513011C4E475A5DA.title: Obtain 1 × Philosopher's Stone
quest.513011C93F33AEB9.quest_desc: Keep MK2 and prepare Red Matter, glowstone and an Ultimate Energy Cube for Collector MK3. This is the top stage of ProjectE’s ordinary collector line.
Compare EMC production with consumer demand under a real workload. If the balance is already rising, the next useful improvement may be transfer or item extraction rather than another collector.
quest.513011C93F33AEB9.title: Obtain 1 × Energy Collector MK3
quest.513011D3B3CABBD0.quest_desc: For the first Dark Matter, surround a diamond block with eight Aeternalis Fuel. Establish alchemical fuel production before making materials for ProjectE upgrades.
Four Dark Matter make one Dark Matter Block. Budget in blocks for the Tablet and AppliedE recipes; one piece of matter does not replace a whole block.
quest.513011D3B3CABBD0.title: Obtain 1 × Dark Matter
quest.513011DCCA214F9C.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Dark Matter Pickaxe (projecte:dm_pick). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011DCCA214F9C.title: Obtain 1 × Dark Matter Pickaxe
